svg.title: Follow one number
svg.desc: Step 1: page 14 of a scanned 310-page Korean rose guide shows a table whose 2019 cultivated area is 247 hectares. Step 2: c2m parses the table into rows and keeps its source: the file hash, page 14, the box on the page, and the steps ingest, parse and flatten. Step 3: a generated training question asks what 차광재배 means; the answer, 볕가림 가꾸기, cites the glossary on page 301 and passed 10 of 10 checks. Step 4: the research export containing it holds 377 SFT, 70 preference and 140 RL rows, and c2m verify confirms all 17 signed files.
